Specifically, we first construct a large-scale, high-quality skill library, and synthesize single-turn and multi-turn skill exploitation trajectories built around these skills with OpenCode. Using these data, we then train a hypernetwork that parameterizes both the skill content and the test-time exploitation methodology by receiving textual skills and converting them into LoRA adapters. Experimental results on six complex software engineering (SWE) subtasks demonstrate that, the proposed ParametricSkills averagely outperforms in-context learning by 6.44 points as judged by DeepSeek-V4-Flash, while also achieving significantly higher BERT Score and F1 score, confirming its effectiveness. Beyond performance, we further find that parametric skills, being inherently accumulative, offer a preliminary yet promising avenue toward test-time continual learning.

</details>


### [354] [Little Brains, Big Feats: Exploring Compact Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30062)
*Dari Baturova,Elena Bruches,Ivan Chernov,Roman Derunets,Arsenii Fomin,Andrey Kostin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究评估了小语言模型在检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的生成性能，结果表明小语言模型无需GPU即可在设备上运行，并在合理时间内完成任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型主导研究，但小语言模型在多个领域仍具相关性却关注不足，因此需要系统评估小语言模型在RAG系统中的生成阶段表现。

Method: 使用开源和专有数据集，覆盖多样化的学科领域和问题类型，对小语言模型在RAG生成阶段进行基准测试。

Result: 配备小语言模型的RAG系统可在无需GPU硬件的设备上直接运行，且在合理时间内完成生成任务。

Conclusion: 小语言模型在RAG系统中具有实用性和高效性，适合在资源受限的设备上部署。

Abstract: While large language models have been dominating the research landscape recently, small language models remain highly relevant across various domains; yet, they receive far less attention. In this study, we investigate how smaller language models perform during the generation stage within a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system. To benchmark these models effectively, we utilised both open-source and proprietary datasets covering diverse subject areas and question types. Our findings demonstrate that a RAG system with small language models can be executed directly on-device without requiring any GPU hardware within a reasonable time. The experimental code and links to the supplementary materials can be accessed through the GitHub repository: https://github.com/SibNN/SLM-RAG-EVAL.

</details>


### [355] [Not-quite-human tastes: the stylized omnivorousness of LLM survey surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30085)
*Xiangyu Ma,Mengmi Zhang,Shannon Ang,Minne Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文利用OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek的大语言模型生成了27.7万个硅代理样本（基于SPPA调查），发现这些硅代理在文化品味模拟上存在系统性偏差：对喜好存在正向偏倚、完全丢失了真实品味结构的复杂关系性、且无法保留品味与社会空间之间已知的文化对齐关系（如年龄、阶级、性别、种族与品味的关联）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在模拟公众态度和观点方面表现出色但存在不一致性，而市场研究公司已开始提供“合成”调查面板，LLM生成的响应也在污染标准调查数据。在此背景下，评估LLM能否产生文化品味的合理近似值成为一个日益紧迫的实证问题。

Method: 使用OpenAI、Anthropic和DeepSeek的大语言模型，每个模型生成277,470个（30×9,249）硅代理样本，基于艺术公众参与调查（SPPA）数据，从算法保真度和对齐角度考察硅采样在文化消费领域的表现。

Result: （1）硅样本存在系统性的正向喜好偏倚，导致生态估计值膨胀，且个体层面偏差不能用文献中常见的WEIRD偏差解释；（2）真实品味结构中的复杂关系性在硅样本中完全丢失；（3）品味与社会空间之间已知的文化对齐关系几乎无法保留：年龄-品味关联被削弱，过时的阶级-品味关联被复活，性别和种族-品味关联被刻板化。

Conclusion: 硅代理样本只能产生高度程式化的人类品味复制品，而非真实反映文化消费的结构和分布，在当前阶段不宜直接替代真实调查数据。

Abstract: Large-language models have proven to be remarkable if inconsistent parrots of public attitudes and opinions. The extent to which LLMs are able to produce reasonable approximations of cultural taste remains an open empirical question that becomes more urgent by the day, with market research companies already offering provisional `synthetic' survey panels and the contamination of standard survey data from LLM-generated responses. In this study, we build on past work on silicon sampling by extending considerations of its algorithmic fidelity and alignment to the domain of cultural consumption. We use large-language models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and DeepSeek to each produce 277,470 (30x9249) silicon surrogates of survey respondents from the Survey of Public Participation in the Arts (SPPA). We find these silicon surrogates' tastes to be highly stylized facsimiles of human tastes. (1) Silicon samples have a systematic postive-bias for liking, resulting in inflated ecological estimates of tastes. The individual-level bias of silicon samples are not well-explained by the WEIRD-bias often discussed in the literature. (2) The complex relationality in real taste structures is completely lost among silicon samples. (3) Finally, very little of the known cultural alignment between tastes and social space are preserved. Silicon samples attenuate age-taste associations, resurrect anachronistic class-taste associations, caricaturize gender- and race-taste associations.

</details>


### [356] [Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Token Co-occurrence Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30093)
*Gianluca Bonifazi,Christopher Buratti,Michele Marchetti,Federica Parlapiano,Giulia Quaglieri,Davide Traini,Domenico Ursino,Luca Virgili*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TIGRAG 是一种基于 token 共现知识图谱的高效图增强检索-生成框架，通过滑动窗口共现统计建模 token 间的拓扑关系，结合图语义扩展与神经重排序，实现多跳推理中的互联证据检索，在三个多跳问答基准上优于密集检索和现有图 RAG 方法，同时显著降低了索引时间、推理延迟和提示开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 RAG 方法在多跳推理中表现不佳，而现有的图 RAG 方法依赖基于 LLM 的提取管线，计算成本高且容易出错。TIGRAG 旨在解决这些瓶颈，提供一种高效、可扩展的图增强 RAG 方案。

Method: 提出基于 token 共现知识图谱的 TIGRAG 框架，利用滑动窗口共现统计直接建模 token 间的拓扑关系，实现可扩展的图构建；推理阶段结合图语义扩展与神经重排序，并通过迭代实体驱动的检索策略逐步扩展查询。

Result: 在三个多跳问答基准上，TIGRAG 在检索和下游 QA 任务中一致优于密集检索和图 RAG 方法，并大幅减少索引时间、推理延迟和提示占用。

Conclusion: TIGRAG 通过 token 共现图高效建模 token 关系，避免了 LLM 提取管线的开销，在多跳推理场景下实现了性能与效率的双重提升。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding the generation process on external knowledge. However, standard RAG approaches struggle with multi-hop reasoning. While recent graph-based RAG methods improve the retrieval of interconnected chunks, they often rely on computationally expensive and error-prone LLM-based extraction pipelines. To address these issues, we propose TIGRAG (Token-Induced GraphRAG), an efficient graph-augmented RAG framework based on a token co-occurrence Knowledge Graph. TIGRAG directly models topological relationships between tokens using sliding-window co-occurrence statistics, thus enabling scalable graph construction. During inference, it combines graph-based semantic expansion and neural reranking to retrieve interconnected evidence for multi-hop reasoning. Specifically, it introduces an iterative entity-driven retrieval strategy that progressively expands the query using bridging entities extracted from previously retrieved contexts. We evaluated TIGRAG on three widely adopted multi-hop Question Answering (QA) benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrated that our framework consistently outperforms dense retrieval and graph-based RAG methods in both retrieval and downstream QA tasks, while substantially reducing indexing time, inference latency, and prompt footprint.

</details>


### [357] [Information Dynamics of Language Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30096)
*Leonardo S. Goodall,Andrea I. Luppi,Pedro A. M. Mediano*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个信息论框架，利用大语言模型作为自然语言的概率估计器，通过语义转移熵（STE）和语义部分信息分解（SPID）两种度量，量化对话中语义内容的定向流动与多源信息贡献（冗余、独特、协同成分）。四个实验验证了该框架在认知僵化对话、说服性话语、心理治疗质量评估和议论文论证分析中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算语言学中缺乏量化语义在交际交换中如何传播的成熟方法，现有方法无法有效捕捉对话中语义内容的定向流动以及多源信息的组合贡献。

Method: 基于信息论框架，利用大语言模型作为自然语言的概率估计器，提出两种度量方法：语义转移熵（STE）用于捕捉说话者之间的定向预测影响，语义部分信息分解（SPID）用于分解多个来源对目标的语义贡献为冗余、独特和协同成分。

Result: 四个实验结果表明：该框架能检测认知僵化对话中信息流动的减少；捕捉说服者在塑造话语中的主导作用；通过治疗师-来访者信息交换的方向性区分高、低质量心理治疗；揭示议论文中协同性的前提贡献。

Conclusion: 该框架为研究数字话语、教学互动、临床对话及其他语言交换结构相关的领域中的信息动态提供了新途径。

Abstract: Quantifying how meaning propagates through communicative exchanges remains underdeveloped in computational linguistics. Here we introduce an information-theoretic framework that quantifies the directed flow of semantic content between interlocutors and decomposes multi-source contributions into redundant, unique, and synergistic components. Our approach leverages large language models as probabilistic estimators of natural language to compute two measures: semantic transfer entropy (STE), which captures directed predictive influence between speakers, and semantic partial information decomposition (SPID), which resolves how multiple sources jointly shape a target's language. Across four experiments we show that the framework detects reduced information flow in cognitively rigid dialogue, captures the dominant role of persuaders in shaping discourse, distinguishes high- from low-quality psychotherapy by the directionality of therapist-client information exchange, and reveals synergistic premise contributions in argumentative essays. This framework opens new avenues for studying information dynamics in digital discourse, pedagogical interactions, clinical dialogues, and any domain in which the structure of linguistic exchange is of research relevance.

</details>


### [358] [Estimating Grammatical Gender Directions in Contextual Embeddings under Controlled and Natural Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30152)
*Huanping Xiao,Yingji Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次尝试在上下文嵌入中解耦西班牙语中的语法性别与社会语义偏见，通过构建平衡数据集和多种性别方向估计器，提出双目标评估指标来抑制语法性别泄漏并保留语义性别区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有性别去偏方法仅针对静态词嵌入，未解决上下文表示中语法性别与社会语义偏见的二维解耦问题。

Method: 构建受控模板和自然Wikipedia上下文的平衡数据集（无生命名词），设计基于质心、SVM和LDA的性别方向估计器及污染感知加权策略，提出双目标评估指标。

Result: 未加权的受控上下文可获得最纯净的语法性别方向，质心估计器优于判别式基线方法。

Conclusion: 该方法能有效在上下文嵌入中分离语法性别与社会语义偏见，为性别去偏提供新思路。

Abstract: Contextual language models conflate grammatical gender and social semantic bias in gendered languages such as Spanish. Existing gender debiasing approaches only operate on static word embeddings leaving contextual representations unexplored for this two dimensional gender disentanglement. To address the this issue, we make the first attempt to disentangle grammatical gender from semantic contamination for contextual embeddings. We construct both controlled templates and natural Wikipedia contexts to build balanced datasets of inanimate nouns, and design a framework equipped with centroid, Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) gender direction estimators as well as contamination-aware weighting strategies. A set of dual-objective evaluation metrics is proposed to balance the suppression of grammatical gender leakage on inanimate nouns and the preservation of semantic gender distinctions for occupation terms. The results reveal that unweighted controlled contexts yield the purest grammatical gender direction, and the centroid estimator achieves better performance than discriminative baselines.

</details>


### [359] [CORTEX: High-Quality Cross-Domain Organization of Web-Scale Corpora through Ontological Corpus Graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30175)
*Chengtao Gan,Xiaoke Guo,Yushan Zhu,Zhaoyan Gong,Zhiqiang Liu,Songze Li,Huajun Chen,Wen Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Cortex是一个将网络规模语料库构建从平面文档筛选提升为结构化知识组织的框架，通过本体语料图（OCG）实现三层异构结构，并验证了其在质量优化、领域组织和跨领域数据合成方面的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的持续演进对数据规模和质量提出更高要求，不同训练阶段对数据的需求日益精细化，但现有语料构建流程仅产生扁平的、无差别的文档集合，缺乏系统性的知识组织。

Method: 提出Cortex框架，核心是构建本体语料图（OCG），一个三层异构结构：质量精炼的内容层、通过LLM驱动的自动演化构建的层次化轻量本体层、支持任意分类粒度跨域关联的跨域对齐层。

Result: 通过综合实验验证了Cortex的有效性，并利用OCG合成CortexBench跨域搜索推理基准，在八个前沿LLM上的评估验证了质量精炼、领域组织和跨域数据合成的效果。

Conclusion: Cortex是首个将网络规模语料构建从平面文档筛选提升到结构化知识组织的框架，并将开源完整代码库、24.14B token的精炼语料及其OCG、以及CortexBench基准。

Abstract: The continuous evolution of large language models drives escalating demands on data scale and quality, and as different training stages impose increasingly tailored data requirements, systematic organization of high-quality corpora becomes indispensable. Existing corpus construction pipelines confine the resulting corpora to flat, undifferentiated document collections, universally lacking systematic knowledge organization. We present Cortex, to our knowledge the first framework that elevates web-scale corpus construction from flat document filtering to structured knowledge organization through an Ontological Corpus Graph (OCG), a three-layer heterogeneous structure unifying a quality-refined content layer, a hierarchical lightweight ontology layer via LLM-driven automated evolution, and a cross-domain alignment layer enabling inter-domain association at arbitrary taxonomic resolution. Comprehensive experiments confirm the effectiveness of Cortex. In particular, we leverage the OCG to synthesize CortexBench, a cross-domain search-and-reasoning benchmark whose evaluation across eight frontier LLMs validates the effectiveness of quality refinement, domain organization, and cross-domain data synthesis. We will publicly release the complete codebase, a 24.14B-token refined corpus with its OCG, and CortexBench.

</details>


### [360] [DAIN: Dynamic Agent-Based Interaction Network for Efficient and Collaborative Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30189)
*Xinxin Chen,Yuchen Li,Zihan Wang,Haoyu Zhang,Ruixin Liu,Mingyuan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出动态智能体交互网络(DAIN)，将多模态融合重构为动态多智能体协作过程，通过上下文感知元控制器动态调度稀疏交互智能体，在五个基准上取得新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于静态MoE架构的多模态融合方法难以提供复杂真实应用所需的自适应和高效协作推理能力。

Method: DAIN包含上下文感知元控制器，动态调度稀疏激活的专门交互智能体，并编排压缩的智能体间通信以达成共识；通过多目标损失函数联合优化任务准确率、智能体专业化和操作效率。

Result: 在ADNI、MIMIC-IV、MM-IMDB、CMU-MOSI、ENRICO五个基准上取得新SOTA，ADNI上准确率提升2.6%；消融实验验证了动态调度和智能体通信的关键作用。

Conclusion: DAIN通过动态智能体范式为多模态推理提供了增强的可解释性和计算效率，展示了动态智能体范式的潜力。

Abstract: Current multimodal fusion approaches, particularly those based on static Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, often struggle to provide the adaptive and efficient collaborative reasoning required by complex real-world applications. We introduce the Dynamic Agent-based Interaction Network (DAIN), which reconceptualizes multimodal fusion as a dynamic, multi-agent collaborative process. DAIN employs a context-aware Meta-Controller that dynamically schedules sparse activation of specialized interaction agents and orchestrates compressed inter-agent communication for consensus-building. The framework is guided by a multi-objective loss function that jointly optimizes task accuracy, agent specialization, and operational efficiency through sparse activation and communication regularization. Comprehensive evaluations across five diverse benchmarks -- ADNI, MIMIC-IV, MM-IMDB, CMU-MOSI, and ENRICO -- establish DAIN as a new state-of-the-art, delivering significant performance improvements including a 2.6\% accuracy gain on ADNI. Ablation studies verify the critical roles of both dynamic scheduling and agent communication. Furthermore, DAIN offers enhanced interpretability by exposing context-dependent agent roles and collaboration patterns while maintaining computational efficiency through sample-wise sparse agent activation. Our work demonstrates the promise of dynamic, agent-based paradigms for multimodal reasoning.

</details>


### [361] [Forewarned is Forearmed: When Non-Sequential Embedding Turns Into an Anomaly Detector](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30196)
*Elys Allesiardo,Antoine Caubrière,Valentin Vielzeuf*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文深入分析非序列多模态句子级嵌入（特别是SONAR模型），发现某些嵌入维度对扰动敏感，可作为解码异常的指标。利用编码-解码一致性构建了精确检测器，并探索通过修改特定维度进行修正，强调了理解嵌入本身对提升多模态表示可靠性的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态表示（如SONAR嵌入）缺乏对其内部结构的深入理解，尤其是哪些维度在解码过程中起关键作用、如何检测和纠正解码异常等问题尚未解决，因此需要系统分析嵌入维度特性以提升多模态表示的可靠性。

Method: 1) 分析SONAR非序列多模态句子级嵌入的维度敏感性；2) 利用编码-解码一致性构建异常检测器；3) 探索通过修改特定目标维度来纠正解码异常的方法。

Result: 成功构建了基于编码-解码一致性的精确异常检测器，并验证了特定嵌入维度可作为解码异常的指标，同时初步探索了维度修正的有效性。

Conclusion: 深入理解嵌入向量本身的结构特性对于提升多模态表示的可靠性和鲁棒性至关重要，未来的工作应继续探索嵌入分析在更广泛多模态任务中的应用。

Abstract: This paper offers an in-depth analysis of non-sequential multimodal sentence-level embeddings, with a particular focus on the SONAR model. We demonstrate that certain embedding dimensions are sensitive to perturbations and can serve as indicators of decoding anomalies. By leveraging the consistency between successive encoding and decoding, we successfully build an accurate detector. Additionally, we explore modifying specific dimensions of interest to attempt to correct them. This work underscores the importance of understanding and analyzing the embeddings themselves to enhance the reliability of multimodal representations.

</details>


### [362] [Before Thinking, Learn to Decide: Proactive Routing for Efficient Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30217)
*Yinan Zhou,Haokun Lin,Yichen Wu,Caifeng Shan,Zhenan Sun,Yuxin Chen,Teng Wang,Chen Ma,Li Zhu,Ying Shan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出PRP主动路由范式，通过Draft Rating Learning和Joint Rating Learning分别评估草稿模型和目标模型的能力，实现细粒度实例级路由，在多模态推理中兼顾效率与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型推理效率受限于长思维链，而配对草稿模型与目标模型的协作推理方案在多模态场景下缺乏可靠的问题难度信号，现有方法要么依赖后验token概率（多模态场景失效），要么依赖有监督微调（数据敏感），且仅在完整输出后才进行路由，忽略了目标模型是否真正能解决路由实例。

Method: 提出Proactive Routing Paradigm (PRP)，包含两个核心组件：1) Draft Rating Learning (DRL) - 为草稿模型配备内部置信度估计器；2) Joint Rating Learning (JRL) - 预测目标模型处理给定查询的能力，优先分配目标模型擅长的样本而非最难的样本。两者结合实现早期决策的细粒度实例级主动路由。

Result: 在多个多模态推理基准上验证了PRP的有效性和效率，在不牺牲整体性能的前提下显著加速推理过程。

Conclusion: 通过主动评估草稿模型和目标模型的联合能力实现早期路由决策，比传统后验路由范式更适合多模态场景，为高效多模态推理提供了新思路。

Abstract: Large multimodal models have achieved strong reasoning on complex visual tasks, but their inference efficiency is often restricted by long chains of thought. A promising solution is to pair a small draft model with a large target model, enabling cooperative inference employing a routing signal that adaptively routes queries to either the draft or target model based on their difficulties for optimal efficiency and accuracy. Yet, the remaining bottleneck is to establish a reliable query difficulty signal under multimodal settings. Existing approaches designed for language models either rely on post-hoc token probabilities, which fall short in multimodal scenarios, or depend on supervised fine-tuning, which is a data-sensitive strategy. Both paradigms perform routing only after a complete output, and ignore whether the target model can actually solve the routed instances. To address this, we propose PRP, a Proactive Routing Paradigm that enables early decision-making by jointly evaluating the competence of both the draft and target models. Our Draft Rating Learning (DRL) equips the draft model with an internal confidence estimator, while Joint Rating Learning (JRL) predicts how well the target model can handle a given query, thereby prioritizing the allocation of samples it excels at rather than the hardest ones. These ratings enable fine-grained, instance-level \textbf{Proactive Routing} and substantially accelerate inference without compromising overall performance. Extensive experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks validate our effectiveness and efficiency.

</details>


### [363] [CaresAI at CT-DEB26: Detecting Dosing Errors In Clinical Trials Using Domain-Specific Transformer Embeddings and Classification Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30236)
*Leon Hamnett,Favour Igwezeke,Joseph Itopa Abubakar,Mary Adetutu Adewunmi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文使用领域特定的Transformer模型（如BioBERT）对临床试验文本进行编码，并结合结构化元数据，通过机器学习分类器预测剂量错误风险，BioBERT嵌入结合逻辑回归基线达到0.794 ROC-AUC，梯度提升等模型最高达0.853，证明了域对齐嵌入对提升用药安全监测的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 剂量错误是临床试验中可预防但危害严重的问题，早期识别可提高试验完整性并减轻临床和财务负担。现有方法缺乏对试验协议文本语义的深度利用，因此本文旨在评估基于生物医学语料训练的Transformer模型对剂量错误的检测能力。

Method: 使用ClinicalBERT、PubMedBERT、BioBERT和MedCPT四种领域Transformer模型对临床试验协议文本进行编码，结合分类特征。将文本嵌入作为输入，使用逻辑回归、梯度提升、支持向量机等经典机器学习模型以及残差神经网络进行二分类预测，评估ROC-AUC指标。

Result: BioBERT在逻辑回归基线中表现最佳（ROC-AUC 0.794），较ClinicalBERT提升3.95%。多嵌入融合未带来提升，提示域对齐优于表征堆叠。梯度提升、SVM、逻辑回归和残差神经网络达到最强性能（ROC-AUC 0.821–0.853）。

Conclusion: 域特定Transformer嵌入与结构化元数据的集成能够有效区分高剂量错误风险的临床试验方案，推动了安全性监测能力，并为监管决策提供了数据支持。

Abstract: Medication errors, particularly dosing errors in clinical trials (CT), can lead to patient harm, adverse drug events and worse patient outcomes. Dosing errors are preventable, and early identification can improve trial integrity and mitigate subsequent clinical and financial burden. This study aims to detect dosing errors within CT protocols by evaluating text representations of trial information using transformer-based language models trained on biomedical corpora. CT textual data was encoded using several models, including ClinicalBERT, PubMedBERT, BioBERT, and MedCPT, and integrated with categorical features. These text embeddings were used as input to classical machine learning models and neural network architectures within an experimental framework. Performance was primarily assessed using ROC-AUC with respect to predicting dosage error. Under a logistic regression baseline, BioBERT consistently outperformed alternative encoders, achieving an ROC-AUC of 0.794, a 3.95% improvement over the ClinicalBERT baseline. Combining multiple embeddings did not yield improvements, indicating that domain alignment outweighs representational stacking. Gradient boosting models, support vector classifiers, logistic regression, and residual neural networks achieved the strongest performance for predicting dosage error, achieving ROC-AUCs: 0.821 to 0.853. Overall, the integration of domain-specific transformer embeddings with structured metadata enables discrimination of trials meeting a predefined elevated dosing error risk criterion, advancing safety monitoring and supporting informed regulatory decision-making.

</details>


### [364] [Comparing Human and Automatic Recognition of Dutch Dysarthric Continuous Speech: A Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30237)
*Yuanyuan Zhang,Dimme de Groot,Jorge Martinez,Odette Scharenborg*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究比较了人类听者和三种商用ASR系统（Whisper-large-V3、Google Chirp 3、Omnilingual）对单一重度构音障碍患者荷兰语连续朗读和自发言语的识别表现。结果显示，人类和ASR系统平均词错误率均超过70%；微调后的个性化DSR模型虽仍高于23%的WER，但已超越人类听者，接近可支持日常交流的水平。未来研究应聚焦于提升自发言语和长句朗读的识别性能，特别是特定音素的识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发个性化构音障碍言语识别（DSR）模型，改善构音障碍患者的日常交流能力。

Method: 比较人类听者与三种商用ASR系统（Whisper-large-V3、Google Chirp 3、Omnilingual）对单一重度构音障碍患者的荷兰语连续朗读和自发言语的识别表现，并对ASR系统进行微调以构建个性化DSR模型。

Result: 人类听者和三种商用ASR系统平均WER均超过70%；微调后个性化DSR模型的WER显著降低但仍高于23%，但已优于人类听者。

Conclusion: 个性化DSR模型虽仍存在较高WER，但已超越人类听者，接近可支持日常交流的水平；未来需重点提升自发言语和长句朗读的识别性能，特别是特定音素的识别。

Abstract: In our goal to develop personalised dysarthric speech recognition (DSR) models, this study compared the recognition performances of human listeners and those of three state-of-the-art, off-the-shelf ASR systems (Whisper-large-V3, Google Chirp 3, and Omnilingual) on the recognition of Dutch continuous read and spontaneous speech from a single speaker with severe dysarthria. Results showed that both humans listeners and the three off-the-shelf ASR systems exhibit word error rates (WER) exceeding 70% on average, indicating that DSR is highly challenging for both humans and ASR systems. Fine-tuning on the dysarthric speech significantly reduced WER. Although overall WERs are still quite high (>23%), the personalised DSR models outperformed the human listeners, and performance is getting closer to being useful for supporting day-to-day communication of dysarthric speakers. Future research should focus on improving personalized DSR on spontaneous speech and longer utterances in the case of read speech, with a specific focus on particular phonemes.

</details>


### [365] [Grounding LLM Reasoning under Incomplete Graph Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30247)
*Jiaqi Li,Fanghui Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个理论框架，将大语言模型在知识图谱证据不完备条件下的推理轨迹进行软接地（soft grounding）分析，证明硬规则无法同时拒绝虚假轨迹和保留真实但未观测的轨迹，并通过KL正则化变形实现有限松弛的软约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的知识图谱辅助LLM推理方法通常假设图谱是完备的真相，但实际中图谱是检索得到的、链接的、时间受限的、不完备的证据状态。需要从理论上理解在这种不完备证据下如何可靠地将LLM推理轨迹接地到图谱证据上。

Method: 建立了一个理论框架：将证据状态建模为实体锚点、类型化关系残差、路径能量和支持区域；将LLM视为提供候选轨迹先验；将软接地刻画为KL正则化的先验变形（有限松弛保留未被支持但不矛盾的轨迹），硬条件约束作为无穷惩罚极限；并推导了证据扰动下的稳定性界。

Result: 证明了在开放世界不完备假设下，仅基于观测状态的硬规则无法同时满足：拒绝所有虚假且无支持的轨迹 + 保留所有真实但未观测的轨迹。证明了软接地框架下的有限松弛可以解决这一两难问题。给出了证据扰动下的稳定性界。阐明了不同约束机制在GraphRAG、KGQA、图智能体、约束解码和忠实生成等任务中的适用条件。

Conclusion: KG兼容性应被视为声明性支持（declared support）而非事实性真相（factual truth）；软接地框架为设计面向不完备图谱的LLM推理系统提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Knowledge graphs can guide large language models (LLMs) reasoning, but the graph seen by a system is usually a retrieved, linked, temporally scoped, and incomplete evidence state rather than a complete account of truth. We develop a theoretical perspective on grounding observable LLM trajectories under such incomplete graph evidence.The evidence state induces entity anchors, typed relation residuals, path energies, and support regions, while the language model supplies a prior over candidate trajectories. We show that, under open-world incompleteness, no hard rule based only on the observed state can both reject every false unsupported trajectory and retain every true-but-unobserved one.We then characterize soft grounding as a KL-regularized deformation of the LLM prior: finite slack preserves support for unsupported but non-contradicted trajectories, whereas hard conditioning appears as an infinite-penalty limit.The framework also yields stability bounds under evidence perturbations and clarifies the constraint regimes appropriate for GraphRAG, KGQA, graph agents, constrained decoding, and faithful generation. The claims are evidence-relative: KG compatibility is treated as declared support, not factual truth.

</details>


### [366] [Multi-Agentic System Leveraging Open-Source LLMs to Mitigate Disinformation Threats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30259)
*Sebastian Kula,Martin Tamajka*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多智能体系统的虚假信息检测方法，通过模拟人类标注者的决策过程，结合共识机制、认知多样性、知识多样性和层次化结构，在多种语言（英语、波兰语、斯洛伐克语、保加利亚语）和多项任务上取得了优于GPT-4和GPT-3.5等单个大语言模型的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当代社会虚假信息威胁日益严重，电子通信、社交媒体和人工智能的发展加剧了这一威胁。人工事实核查难以应对大规模虚假信息，亟需自动化检测方法。

Method: 提出基于多智能体系统的方法，模拟人类标注者的决策过程。系统包含共识机制、认知多样性、知识多样性以及层次化结构，使用开源大语言模型（如LLaMA、Kimi、Qwen、Deepseek、LLaMA-Nemotron）以保证透明性。

Result: 在英语（高资源）、波兰语（中资源）、斯洛伐克语（低资源）和保加利亚语（低资源）数据集上，在直接虚假信息检测、可验证文本识别、包含可验证事实主张的文本检测等任务中，该方法优于GPT-4和GPT-3.5等单个大语言模型。

Conclusion: 多智能体系统通过模拟人类协作决策机制，在虚假信息检测任务中具有显著优势，尤其在不同资源水平的语言场景下均表现优异，为自动化虚假信息检测提供了有效且透明的解决方案。

Abstract: In contemporary societies, the threat of disinformation has reached alarming levels, exacerbated by the proliferation of electronic communication, social media, and advancements in artificial intelligence. As a result, there is an urgent need to develop effective countermeasures to mitigate this menace. However, the sheer scale of the problem renders manual fact-checking and human-based verification inadequate, underscoring the necessity for automated methods to detect and debunk disinformation. This article proposes a novel approach based on a multi-agent system that emulates the decision-making processes of human annotators engaged in disinformation detection tasks. By incorporating a consensus mechanism, diversity in cognition and diversity in knowledge, and also hierarchical structure, inspired by human annotators' behavior, the proposed method achieves superior results compared to individual Large Language Models (LLMs), including GPT 4 and GPT 3.5. The system leverages open models (e.g., LLaMA, Kimi, Qwen, Deepseek and LLaMA-Nemotron) to ensure greater transparency. The evaluation of the proposed method encompasses datasets in languages with varying resource availability, including English (high-resource), Polish (medium-resource), Slovak (low-resource) and Bulgarian (low-resource). Experiments were conducted on tasks such as direct disinformation detection, identification of texts worthy of verification, and detection of texts containing verifiable factual claims.

</details>


### [367] [DialogPII: A multilingual dataset of synthetic dialog transcripts to detect personal information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30312)
*Roland Roller,Vera Czehmann,Derya Erman,Luke Flanagan,Ibrahim Baroud,Frédéric Blain,Viviana Cotik,Eletta Giusto,Akhil Juneja,Mariana Neves,Maria Słowińska,Christine Hovhannisyan,Aaron Louis Eidt,Lisa Raithel,Sebastian Möller,Maija Poikela*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了DialogPII，一个多语言、多场景的合成对话数据集，用于检测个人身份信息（PII）。数据集涵盖8种交互场景、19种实体类型和11种语言，包含书面对话和语音转录文本，并提供了基准模型和技术验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗、社会科学等领域的对话数据是宝贵的研究资源，但负责任地共享这些数据需要检测和移除个人身份信息及敏感信息以保护隐私。目前缺乏多语言、多场景的对话PII检测数据集，尤其是包含语音转录场景的资源。

Method: 半自动方式：使用大语言模型生成对话，人工进行合理性和多样性筛选，并本地化至特定国家和城市语境。通过文本转语音合成将对话转为语音，再用Whisper进行转录。通过自动投影和人工校正进行标注，最终获得对齐的书面和语音转录资源。

Result: 生成了覆盖8种交互场景、19种实体类型、11种语言的多模态对话数据集，包含书面对话和语音转录文本对齐资源。还发布了基准多语言命名实体识别模型，并通过标注者间一致性分析、翻译质量评估、标注投影评估以及Transformer序列标注模型基准实验提供了技术验证。

Conclusion: DialogPII为多语言对话场景下的自动去标识化系统开发和评估提供了重要资源，填补了语音转录场景下PII检测数据集的空白。实验验证了数据集的质量和可用性，为后续研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: Conversational data collected in domains such as healthcare or social sciences is a valuable resource for research and automated analysis. However, responsible data sharing requires the detection and removal of personally identifiable and sensitive information to protect individual privacy. To support the development and evaluation of automatic de-identification systems, we present DialogPII, a multilingual dataset of synthetic dialogs and speech-derived transcripts for personal information detection. DialogPII covers eight interaction scenarios (emergency calls, medical anamnesis interviews, therapy sessions, insurance communication, customer support, clinical interviews regarding an AI-supported dashboard, police reports, and group therapy discussions), 19 entity types, and 11 languages (English, Arabic, Finnish, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish, and Turkish). Dialogs were generated semi-automatically using large language models, manually curated for plausibility and diversity, and localized to country- and city-specific contexts. All dialogs were additionally converted to speech via text-to-speech synthesis, transcribed with Whisper, and annotated through automatic projection and manual correction, yielding aligned written and speech-derived resources across all languages. We further release baseline multilingual named entity recognition models and provide technical validation through inter-annotator agreement analysis, translation quality evaluation, annotation projection assessment, and benchmark experiments with transformer-based sequence labeling models.

</details>


### [368] [REAR: Test-time Preference Realignment through Reward Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30339)
*Fuxiang Zhang,Pengcheng Wang,Chenran Li,Yi-Chen Li,Yuxin Chen,Lang Feng,Chenfeng Xu,Masayoshi Tomizuka,Bo An*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出REAR框架，将偏好对齐建模为重新对齐问题，通过分解奖励函数并重构为策略对数概率的线性组合，实现了无需额外训练的高效测试时缩放对齐，实验结果验证了其在多种任务上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练方法虽能适配模型，但需要昂贵的数据整理和额外训练；而测试时缩放方法虽高效，却局限于数学和编程等可验证领域。本文旨在将TTS扩展到偏好对齐领域，解决模型初始对齐不足的问题。

Method: 将偏好对齐重新定义为重新对齐问题；将潜在奖励函数分解为与问题相关和与偏好信息相关的两个分量；推导出REAR奖励，选择性重新缩放这两个奖励项的占比；将REAR形式化为token级策略对数概率的线性组合，便于与best-of-N采样和树搜索等TTS算法集成。

Result: 相比其他测试时基线方法，REAR在多样化的用户需求下实现了可扩展的测试时重新对齐；在适当的偏好设置下，还能泛化到数学和视觉任务。

Conclusion: REAR框架成功将测试时缩放扩展到偏好对齐领域，兼具计算高效性和算法通用性，为无需额外训练的LLM偏好对齐提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse user preferences is a critical yet challenging task. While post-training methods can adapt models to specific needs, they often require costly data curation and additional training. Test-time scaling (TTS) presents an efficient, training-free alternative, but its application has been largely limited to verifiable domains like mathematics and coding, where response correctness is easily judged. To extend TTS to preference alignment, we introduce a novel framework that models the task as a realignment problem, since the base model often fails to sufficiently align with the stated preference. Our key insight is to decompose the underlying reward function into two components: one related to the question and the other to preference information. This allows us to derive a REAlignment Reward (REAR) that selectively rescales the proportions of these two reward terms. We then show that REAR can be formulated as a linear combination of token-level policy log-probabilities, making it computationally efficient and easy to integrate with various TTS algorithms such as best-of-$N$ sampling and tree search. Experiments show that compared to other test-time baselines, REAR not only enables scalable test-time realignment for preference alignment tasks under diverse user requirements, but also generalizes to mathematical and visual tasks under appropriate preference settings.

</details>


### [369] [OLIVE: View-Augmented Latent Prediction with Waveform Reconstruction for Speech SSL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30356)
*Karl El Hajal,Mathew Magimai. -Doss*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: OLIVE是一种自监督语音表示学习框架，通过联合优化分析（视图增强掩码潜在预测）与合成（波形重建）目标，使早期编码器保留信号级信息，后期上下文表示获得不变性，从而在生成、说话人、识别、语义和波形重建任务上取得全面提升或竞争性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督语音表示学习方法通常仅关注分析（如掩码预测）或合成（如重建）单一目标，难以同时兼顾下游任务性能与信号级信息保留。作者希望设计一个统一框架，同时优化分析与合成目标，使表示既能支持识别/语义等理解任务，又能支持生成和说话人任务。

Method: 提出OLIVE框架，联合优化两个目标：(1) 视图增强的掩码潜在预测（view-augmented masked latent prediction），对掩码区域的潜在表示进行预测，增强上下文表示的不变性；(2) 波形重建（waveform reconstruction），约束早期编码器特征保留完整的信号级信息。两个目标在统一的损失函数下联合优化。

Result: OLIVE在生成任务和说话人任务上取得显著提升；在识别和语义任务上保持竞争性表现；波形重建质量得到改善。整体上支持广泛的下游任务范围。

Conclusion: 联合优化分析与合成目标是有效的自监督语音表示学习策略，早期重建约束保证信号级信息不丢失，后期不变性约束提升下游任务鲁棒性，两种目标互补使得单一模型能够同时胜任理解和生成类任务。

Abstract: We propose Online Latent prediction with Invariant Views and rEconstruction (OLIVE), a self-supervised speech representation learning framework that jointly optimizes analysis and synthesis objectives. OLIVE combines view-augmented masked latent prediction with waveform reconstruction under a unified objective. Reconstruction constrains early encoder features to retain signal-level information, while masked latent prediction shapes later contextual representations toward invariance for robust downstream performance. We show that these objectives enable representations that support a broad range of tasks. In particular, OLIVE improves results on generation and speaker tasks, maintains competitive performance on recognition and semantic tasks, and improves waveform reconstruction.

</details>


### [370] [MOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Integration in LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30406)
*Wenhan Ma,Jianyu Wei,Liang Zhao,Hailin Zhang,Bangjun Xiao,Lei Li,Qibin Yang,Bofei Gao,Yudong Wang,Rang Li,Jinhao Dong,Zhifang Sui,Fuli Luo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）范式，通过先训练领域专家教师、再在学生自生成轨迹上蒸馏的方式，高效整合多个领域能力，在Qwen3-30B-A3B上超越现有方法，并已部署至工业级模型MiMo-V2-Flash。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法如Off-Policy Finetune效率低、Mix-RL性能损失大，难以在保持各领域能力的同时高效集成多个强化学习教师的能力。

Method: 先对各领域分别进行强化学习训练获得领域教师，然后在学生模型自身的在线采样轨迹上对这些教师进行蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation），消除暴露偏差并提供密集优化信号。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，MOPD在各项指标上优于Mix-RL、Cascade RL、Off-Policy Finetune和参数合并基线，几乎完整继承了每个教师的能力，并已成功部署到工业级模型MiMo-V2-Flash中。

Conclusion: MOPD是一种高效的多能力集成后训练范式，支持领域教师并行独立开发，避免了跨领域耦合问题，在大规模语言模型后训练中具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) rely on reinforcement learning during post-training to push specific capabilities, yet integrating multiple capabilities into one model remains hard. Existing methods, such as Off-Policy Finetune and Mix-RL, are either inefficient or lose performance. In this work, we propose Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), a post-training paradigm for combining the capabilities of multiple domain RL teachers: we first run per-domain specialised RL to obtain a set of domain teachers, then distill these teachers into the student on its own rollouts. This eliminates exposure bias and provides a dense optimization signal. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, MOPD outperforms Mix-RL, Cascade RL, Off-Policy Finetune, and Param-Merge baselines, inheriting nearly all of each teacher's capability. MOPD also enables parallel, independent development of domain teachers, removing the cross-domain coupling typical of multi-domain post-training. MOPD has been deployed in the post-training of MiMo-V2-Flash, an industrial-scale frontier model, demonstrating its practical value for capability integration in frontier-scale LLMs.

</details>


### [371] [Field Order Should Not Matter: Permutation-Invariant Embedding Model Fine-Tuning for Structured Metadata Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30473)
*Aivin V. Solatorio,Olivier Dupriez,Rafael Macalaba*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出排列不变微调（PI-FT），解决结构化元数据检索中字段顺序影响检索质量的问题；同时发布DevDataBench基准，展示小模型经微调后性能优于大型零样本模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化元数据检索中，序列化记录时的字段顺序选择通常被视为实现细节，但标准微调后索引重建时字段顺序变化会导致检索质量显著下降（7.4 nDCG@10）。需要一种对字段顺序鲁棒的微调方法。

Method: 提出排列不变微调（PI-FT）：每次训练时对每条记录随机采样字段顺序并进行随机字段丢弃，使模型将语义绑定到字段标签而非绝对位置。同时构建DevDataBench——一个完全由LLM生成的、覆盖15种语言、每个指标都有对应查询的基准数据集。

Result: PI-FT将顺序变化带来的性能损失从7.4降至0.2 nDCG@10，分布内准确度几乎无损。微调的118M参数CPU编码器在DevDataBench上以0.707 nDCG@10超越text-embedding-3-large的0.556，在低资源语言上增益最大。

Conclusion: 字段顺序是检索质量的关键因素，PI-FT简单有效地解决了该问题；小模型结合高质量微调数据可超越大型通用嵌入模型；DevDataBench及PI-FT框架可促进数据通过AI进行传播。

Abstract: We study retrieval over catalogs of structured metadata, where each record is a small schema whose fields answer different kinds of query. Embedding a record with a text encoder first serializes its fields into a string, which forces a choice of field order. We show this choice, usually treated as an implementation detail, silently controls retrieval quality once the encoder is fine-tuned. A standard fine-tune loses 7.4 nDCG@10 points when the index is rebuilt under a different field order, because it reads absolute position instead of the field labels. We propose permutation-invariant fine-tuning ($\textbf{PI-FT}$), which serializes each record under a freshly sampled field order with random field dropout, so meaning binds to the labels rather than to position. The change is about two lines in the data loader; it costs negligible in-distribution accuracy and cuts the order-change penalty to 0.2 points. We study this in the discovery of development statistics, a catalog of nearly 10,000 indicators that should be searchable in many languages by a model small enough to self-host. As AI assistants and agents increasingly mediate access to public data and statistics, this retrieval step decides whether an answer is grounded in the right indicator or series, making discoverability a precondition for disseminating data through AI. Because usage logs cannot provide training signal for indicators no one has searched, we generate the queries instead. $\textbf{DevDataBench}$ is a fully LLM-generated benchmark of grounded, facet-targeted queries across 15 languages, covering every indicator for both training and evaluation. A fine-tuned 118M-parameter CPU encoder outperforms every zero-shot baseline, including $\texttt{text-embedding-3-large}$ (0.707 vs.\ 0.556 nDCG@10), with the largest gains in low-resource languages. We release the benchmark, pipeline, models, and a reusable PI-FT framework.

</details>


### [372] [SIMAX: A Scalable and Interpretable Framework for Multi-Fidelity and Annotated Clinician-Patient Dialogue Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30491)
*Zhuhan Bao,Rui Yang,Bohao Yang,Zhiyi Liu,Sicheng Shu,Ruio Heerschap,Le Li,Doris Yang,Elisabeth Bond,Haoyuan Wang,Nicoleta Economou-Zavlanos,Joshua M. Biro,Matthew McDermott,Nan Liu,Anand Chowdhury,Kai Sun,Kathryn Pollak,Ed Hammond,Chuan Hong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SIMAX框架，用于生成受控的医患对话模拟数据及其对应的行为标注，解决临床沟通编码系统开发中真实标注数据难以大规模获取的问题。通过自动和人工评估验证了生成数据的质量，并展示了其在下游编码系统评估中的应用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实医患对话数据及其人工编码标签难以大规模获取，且人工编码成本高、不一致、难以扩展，制约了AI驱动的临床沟通编码系统的开发与评估。需要一种可扩展、可控的合成数据生成方法。

Method: SIMAX框架从预定义的临床场景、人物角色、语音条件和目标沟通行为出发，通过全局编码册（Global Codebook）和WISER编码册（WISER Codebook）分别控制整体沟通质量和具体可计数行为，生成带有参考行为标注的医患对话数据。

Result: 生成了3,388条模拟对话，覆盖三个专科、多种就诊阶段、人物角色特征和口音条件。自动评估显示UTMOS 3.03、WV-MOS 2.61、WER 0.07、CER 0.05、CLAP余弦相似度0.41；人工评估中位MOS 4.67、中位临床真实感评分3.00；下游评估验证了框架可用于检测编码系统对行为目标的响应能力及维度敏感性不足的问题。

Conclusion: SIMAX能够生成受控且可复现的模拟医患对话，为沟通编码系统的开发、验证和优化提供了可靠的数据基础。

Abstract: Background. The widespread deployment of ambient digital scribes is driving large-scale capture of clinician-patient dialogues. Human coding of clinical communication data remains costly, inconsistent, and difficult to scale, motivating AI-driven communication coding systems. However, evaluating these systems requires real-world dialogues and human-coded labels, both hard to obtain at scale.
  Methods. We developed SIMAX (Scalable and Interpretable Framework for Multi-Fidelity and Annotated Clinician-Patient Dialogue Simulation), a framework for generating controlled clinical dialogue data with reference behavioral annotations. SIMAX generates clinician-patient dialogues from predefined clinical scenarios, personas and voice conditions, and target communication behaviors. Behaviors are controlled using two codebooks: the Global Codebook for overall communication quality and the WISER Codebook for specific countable behaviors. We evaluated SIMAX using automated and human quality assessments and an example communication coding system.
  Results. SIMAX generated 3,388 simulated dialogues across three specialties, multiple visit stages, persona characteristics, and accent conditions. Automated assessment showed mean UTMOS and WV-MOS scores of 3.03 and 2.61, WER and CER of 0.07 and 0.05, and CLAP cosine similarity of 0.41, suggesting reasonable speech naturalness, high transcription fidelity, and positive text-audio correspondence. Human evaluation showed a median MOS of 4.67 and a median clinical realism score of 3.00. Downstream evaluation suggests that SIMAX can assess how a communication coding system responds to behavioral targets and reveal insufficient sensitivity in some dimensions.
  Conclusions. SIMAX generates controlled and reproducible simulated clinician-patient dialogues, providing a data foundation for developing, validating, and refining communication coding systems.

</details>


### [373] [Regime-Aware Peer Specialization for Robust RAG under Heterogeneous Knowledge Conflicts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30518)
*Bo Wang,Heyan Huang,Yaolin Li,Yanghao Zhou,Jiahao Teng,Ziyi Yang,Ge Shi,Chong Feng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RAPS-DA提出了一种基于"制度感知"的专家分工框架，通过样本级三制度路由（Grounding/Arbitration/Resistance）和令牌级双层选择器，解决RAG中检索上下文与参数知识冲突时的异构学习信号混淆问题，在五个冲突场景和两个OOD基准上超越多种基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG中检索到的上下文可能与模型参数知识存在冲突，且这些冲突覆盖从可靠、部分可靠到对抗性证据的可靠性谱系。现有方法通常采用制度无关的监督方式处理这种异构冲突，会混叠不同可靠性制度下的不兼容学习信号，导致训练信号相互干扰。

Method: 提出RAPS-DA框架，包含两个互补粒度：(1) 样本级：将冲突分为Grounding（可靠）、Arbitration（部分可靠）、Resistance（对抗）三个制度，从共享基座模型训练三个同规模专家（peer specialist），每个样本硬路由到对应专家进行on-policy反向KL监督；(2) 令牌级：双层选择器利用教师间分歧、学生-教师差异和学生熵，过滤无信息/不稳定令牌，对高置信度错配令牌加权，随学生成熟逐步聚焦高冲突令牌。

Result: 在五个冲突场景和两个OOD基准上，RAPS-DA超越了所有prompting、decoding、fine-tuning、RL和单教师基线方法。

Conclusion: 性能提升源自固定模型规模下的专业化分工，而非更强的教师模型；专家仅在训练阶段存在，部署时学生模型无需制度标签或专家访问。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language models by grounding generation in external context. However, it can be fragile when the retrieved context conflicts with the model's parametric knowledge. Such conflicts span a reliability spectrum, ranging from reliable and partially reliable evidence to adversarial context. Existing remedies often handle such heterogeneous conflicts with regime-agnostic supervision, which can conflate incompatible learning signals across reliability regimes. To disentangle these signals, we propose RAPS-DA, a regime-aware peer specialization framework that addresses conflict at two complementary granularities. At the sample level, conflicts are divided into three regimes, including Grounding, Arbitration, and Resistance, with one same-scale peer specialist trained per regime from a shared base model. Each sample is then hard-routed to its regime-matched peer for on-policy reverse-KL supervision. At the token level, a dual-layer selector uses inter-teacher disagreement, student-teacher divergence, and student entropy to filter uninformative or unstable tokens, upweight confidently misaligned ones, and gradually focus supervision on high-conflict tokens as the student matures. Gains stem from specialization at a fixed model scale, not from a stronger teacher, and the peer specialists exist only during training, so the deployed student requires no regime labels or peer access. Experiments on five conflict scenarios and two out-of-distribution benchmarks show RAPS-DA surpasses all prompting, decoding, fine-tuning, RL, and single-teacher baselines.

</details>


### [374] [TRACE: Temporal Relationship-Aware Conversational Entrainment Detection in Dyadic Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30543)
*Sathvik Manikantan Napa Ugandhar,Hao Zhang,Alison Gunzler,Yuzhe Wang,Thomas Thebaud,Georgi Tinchev,Venkatesh Ravichandran,Laureano Moro-Velázquez*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DyadEE数据集和TRACE框架，用于检测双人语音对话中的情感韵律同步。DyadEE包含自然情感同步对话和通过伙伴交换与情感重合成破坏同步的合成对话；TRACE则是一个窗口级框架，将双人交互建模为基于情感微调Whisper声学嵌入的有序序列。实验表明，结合对话上下文和关系信息可提升检测效果，TRACE达到97.01%的最佳准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着语音AI代理的普及，理解对话交互中的情感韵律同步变得日益重要。情感韵律同步受社会关系和对话语境影响，但目前缺乏专门的数据集和有效的检测方法。

Method: 构建DyadEE数据集，包含自然情感同步对话和经伙伴交换及情感重合成处理后的非同步对话；提出TRACE框架，将双人交互视为窗口级有序的声学嵌入序列（基于情感微调Whisper模型），而非简单的语句聚合。

Result: TRACE在DyadEE上达到97.01%的最佳准确率，且融入对话上下文和关系信息能有效提升情感韵律同步检测性能。

Conclusion: 对话上下文和关系信息是情感韵律同步检测的关键因素，TRACE框架通过窗口级序列建模有效捕获了双人交互中的情感协调动态。

Abstract: With the proliferation of speech AI agents, understanding emotional entrainment in conversational interaction has become increasingly important. Emotional entrainment is shaped by social relationships and conversational context, influencing affective coordination over time. We introduce DyadEE, a dataset for emotional entrainment detection in dyadic speech interactions, containing both emotionally entrained conversations and synthetic interactions where entrainment is disrupted through partner swapping and emotion resynthesis. We further propose TRACE, a window-level framework that models dyadic interaction as ordered sequences of acoustic embeddings derived from emotion fine-tuned Whisper representations, treating each sample as an interaction trace rather than pooled utterances. Experimental results on DyadEE show that incorporating conversational context and relationship information improves emotional entrainment detection, with TRACE achieving the best accuracy of 97.01%.

</details>


### [375] [Poller: Are LLMs Suitable for Evaluating the Poetry Understanding Task?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30556)
*Shanshan Wang,Derek F. Wong,Jingming Yao,Lidia S. Chao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Poller方法，通过让大语言模型扮演诗人角色来评估中国现代诗歌理解任务，在八个专业维度上显著降低了评估误差，修辞手法和陌生化维度的误差降低分别达94.55%和89.53%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统自动评估方法不适合现代中国诗歌的独特性，人工评估可靠但成本高昂且不适用于大规模数据，需要一种兼顾自动效率与人类专业性的评估方法。

Method: Poller方法要求LLM扮演具有详细信息的诗歌作者角色，从诗人视角出发模拟人类评估与判断，在八个专业维度上对诗歌解读进行评估。

Result: Poller方法有效降低了LLM与人类之间的评估误差，修辞手法维度误差降低94.55%，陌生化维度误差降低89.53%，在多个LLM和多个维度上验证了有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法弥合了自动化效率与人类专业智慧之间的鸿沟，为诗歌相关任务的自动化评估奠定了基础。

Abstract: Traditional automatic evaluation methods have been shown to be unsuitable for modern Chinese poetry because of the distinct nature of this literary genre. Human evaluation remains reliable, but is expensive and not applicable to large-scale data. In this paper, we propose Poller (Poetry LLM Evaluator), a novel method leveraging large language models (LLMs) to evaluate the poetry understanding task. Specifically, our method requires LLMs to play the role of a poem's author with detailed information, thereby emulating human evaluation and judgment by adopting the poet's perspective. We conducted comprehensive experiments on multiple LLMs, evaluating the interpretations of poems across eight specialized dimensions. Experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively reduces the evaluation error between LLMs and humans. Especially for specific dimension evaluation, Poller-based LLMs achieve a 94.55% and 89.53% error reduction for rhetorical techniques and defamiliarization, respectively, compared to baseline methods. These performances are unattainable by conventional LLM evaluation methods. Experimental results from multiple LLMs across various dimensions validate the efficacy of our method. This work bridges the gap between automated efficiency and human expertise, establishing a foundation for automated evaluation in poetry-related tasks.

</details>


### [376] [Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30562)
*Disen Lan,Jianbin Zheng,Yuxi Ren,Xin Xia,Xuanda Wang,Xuefeng Xiao,Xipeng Qiu,Yu Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FlashMorph提出将混合注意力层选择形式化为预算约束的子集优化问题，通过构建可变形模型、联合优化逐层门控以及离散化门控来高效选择应保留全注意力的层，在降低选择成本的同时保持长上下文召回率和通用性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合注意力模型中全注意力层的选择方法多依赖启发式策略（如固定位置模式或逐层评分），隐式地将层重要性视为孤立属性，忽略了全局混合配置下层间的相互依赖效应。

Method: 1) 构建可变形模型：为每个全注意力层配备转换后的线性注意力分支；2) 冻结全部模型权重，在合成长上下文检索数据上联合优化逐层门控，并引入线性化正则化项；3) 在预设全注意力预算下离散化习得的门控以实例化混合架构，随后进行标准的logits蒸馏和长上下文微调。

Result: FlashMorph能发现更有效的混合配置，在保持强大长上下文召回率和通用基准性能的同时，相比现有层选择方法显著降低了层选择成本。

Conclusion: FlashMorph是一种有效、高效且可扩展的Transformer转混合模型层选择方法，验证了其有效性、效率和可扩展性。

Abstract: Hybrid attention models improve long-context efficiency by retaining only a subset of full-attention layers and replacing the remaining layers with linear attention. However, the effectiveness of Transformer-to-hybrid conversion critically depends on which layers preserve full attention. Existing hybrid layer selection methods typically rely on heuristic strategies such as fixed placement patterns or layerwise scoring, implicitly treating layer importance as isolated and overlooking the interdependent layer effect under a global hybrid configuration. In this work, we formulate hybrid layer selection as a budget-constrained subset optimization problem. We further propose FlashMorph (Fast LAyer Selection for Hybrid MORPHing), an effective, efficient and scalable layer selection method for Transformer-to-hybrid conversion. FlashMorph first constructs a morphable model by equipping each full-attention layer with a converted linear-attention branch. It then freezes all model weights and jointly optimizes layerwise gates on synthetic long-context retrieval data, with a linearization regularization that encourages the model to rely on linear attention for efficiency. The learned gates are discretized under a preset full-attention budget to instantiate the hybrid architecture, followed by standard logits distillation and long-context finetuning. Extensive experiments show that FlashMorph discovers more effective hybrid configurations, preserves strong long-context recall and general benchmark performance while substantially reducing layer selection cost compared with existing layer selection methods, demonstrating its effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability.

</details>


### [377] [Uncertainty-Aware Generation and Decision-Making Under Ambiguity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30578)
*Nico Daheim,Iryna Gurevych*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文基于贝叶斯决策理论和风险规避决策，提出了多种不确定性感知的决策算法，应用于辅导和自动同行评审任务，并使用保形预测提供策略和评分的保证。实验表明这些算法能提升生成效用，但在高模糊性下需谨慎实现：风险规避规则可能因优化通用输出而降低性能，而贝叶斯方法表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM在复杂现实任务中能力快速提升，但许多任务具有高度主观性且需要可信输出，而决策算法方面的研究相对不足。

Method: 基于贝叶斯决策理论和风险规避决策，提出不确定性感知的决策算法；使用保形预测提供策略和评分的保证；在辅导和自动同行评审任务上进行评估。

Result: 算法能提升生成效用，但高模糊性下风险规避规则可能退化为通用输出，贝叶斯方法表现更好。

Conclusion: 决策理论技术可改善LLM决策，同时指出了社区面临的开放性挑战。

Abstract: With rapidly improving capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in many complex real-world tasks. Beyond requiring in-depth knowledge and reasoning skills, many of these tasks exhibit a high degree of subjectivity and require that the outputs of the model can be trusted. While a lot of progress has been made to train better models, decision-making algorithms have received less attention. In this work, we present and evaluate various uncertainty-aware decision-making algorithms based on Bayesian decision theory and risk-averse decision making on the tasks of tutoring and automatic peer reviewing. Concretely, we take uncertainty over tutoring strategies and review scores into account when generating a tutor response or review and use conformal prediction to provide guarantees over strategy and score. We find empirically that these algorithms can improve the utility of the generations but need to be carefully implemented when ambiguity is high. For example, risk-averse rules can degrade performance by optimizing for generic outputs, while Bayesian methods tend to perform better. Our work uses techniques from decision theory to improve LLM-based decision-making and outlines open challenges for the community.

</details>


### [378] [Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30616)
*Lei Bai,Zongsheng Cao,Yang Chen,Zhiyao Cui,Shangheng Du,Yue Fan,Shiyang Feng,Zijie Guo,Haonan He,Liang He,Xiaohan He,Shuyue Hu,Yusong Hu,Songtao Huang,Yichen Jiang,Hao Li,Xin Li,Dahua Lin,Weihao Lin,Fenghua Ling,Dongrui Liu,Zhuo Liu,Runmin Ma,Chunjiang Mu,Haoyang Peng,Tianshuo Peng,Jinxin Shi,Luohe Shi,Boyuan Sun,Zelin Tan,Shengji Tang,Qianyi Wang,Yiming Wu,Yi Xie,Xiangchao Yan,Jingqi Ye,Peng Ye,Fangchen Yu,Jiakang Yuan,Bihao Zhan,Bo Zhang,Chen Zhang,Shufei Zhang,Shuaiyu Zhang,Wenlong Zhang,Yiqun Zhang,Junpeng Zhao,Zhijie Zhong,Bowen Zhou,Yuhao Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了Agents-A1，一个35B参数的混合专家智能体模型，通过扩展智能体视野（agent-horizon）在长周期任务上达到了万亿参数级别的性能。模型采用三阶段训练方法，包括全领域监督微调、领域级教师模型训练和多教师域路由在线蒸馏，在多个长周期智能体基准测试上取得了领先或极具竞争力的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索如何通过扩展智能体视野（包括长周期轨迹扩展和异构智能体能力扩展）来提升模型性能，使得小参数模型（35B）在长周期任务上能够达到或匹配万亿参数模型的水平。

Method: 1) 构建长周期知识-行动基础设施，连接外部知识、行动、观察和验证器结果，生成平均45K token的智能体轨迹。2) 三阶段训练：全领域监督微调→领域级教师模型训练→多教师域路由在线蒸馏（含显著词汇对齐）。

Result: Agents-A1在SEAL-0 (56.4)、IFBench (80.6)、HiPhO (46.4)、FrontierScience-Olympiad (79.0)、MolBench-Bind (56.8)上领先Kimi-K2.6和DeepSeek-V4-pro等1T模型；在SciCode (44.3)、HLE (47.6)、BrowseComp (75.5)上保持高度竞争力。

Conclusion: 35B的Agents-A1通过视野扩展可以在长周期任务上达到或匹配万亿参数模型的性能，为社区提供了一条实用的模型扩展路径。

Abstract: We introduce Agents-A1, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts Agentic Model that reaches trillion-parameter-level performance by scaling the agent horizon. We investigate agent-horizon scaling from two perspectives: scaling long-horizon trajectories and scaling heterogeneous agent abilities. To support this goal, we build a long-horizon knowledge-action infrastructure that connects external knowledge, actions, observations, and verifier outcomes, producing agentic trajectories with an average length of 45K tokens. Based on this, we train Agents-A1 with a three-stage recipe. First, we perform full-domain supervised fine-tuning to align the base model with broad agentic behaviors. Second, we train domain-level teacher models to capture specialized expertise in each domain. Third, we propose a multi-teacher domain-routed on-policy distillation with salient vocabulary alignment to improve knowledge transfer efficiency across different domains, unifying six heterogeneous domains into one deployable student model. Agents-A1 achieves strong and broad performance for long-horizon agent benchmarks. Compared with 1T-parameter model such as Kimi-K2.6 and DeepSeek-V4-pro, Agents-A1 achieves leading results on SEAL-0 (56.4), IFBench (80.6), HiPhO (46.4), FrontierScience-Olympiad (79.0), and MolBench-Bind (56.8), and remains highly competitive on SciCode (44.3), HLE (47.6) and BrowseComp (75.5). We hope this work provides the community with a practical path for scaling the horizon using a 35B agent that can reach or match the performance of 1T models on long-horizon tasks.

</details>

### [379] [Dipole Diffusion Error in Thin Geometry: Optical Thickness Laws for Grid-Free Subsurface Scattering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29387)
*Faruk Alpay,Baris Basaran*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文研究了偶极子次表面散射模型在薄曲物体上的几何误差，推导了有限平板多极子模型的解析解，发现漫反射反照率误差存在材料无关的主导速率 C e^{-2τ}，而透射率的衰减率为 e^{-τ}。通过体积路径追踪验证了这些指数，并提出了厚度预测启发式方法。对于几何依赖项，采用Walk on Spheres方法直接在符号距离域内求解扩散方程，无需内部网格或切半空间近似，在背光、厚度主导场景下表现良好，但无法替代辐射传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统偶极子及其衍生产品假设平坦半无限平板进行次表面散射建模，这一假设在薄且弯曲的物体上引入了系统性几何误差。本文旨在隔离这一误差效应，并提供更精确的解析模型和数值求解方法。

Method: 1) 在相同扩散模型和边界条件下比较偶极子与有限平板多极子；2) 推导漫反射反照率和透射率的闭合形式解析解；3) 通过暴力体积路径追踪验证指数预测；4) 采用Walk on Spheres方法在符号距离域内直接求解屏蔽泊松扩散问题。

Result: 漫反射反照率误差的材料无关主导速率为 C e^{-2τ}（τ=T/ℓ_d），透射率的衰减率为 e^{-τ}。体积路径追踪验证了反射率缺损率1.99（与往返路径预测一致）和透射率0.99（与单程预测一致）。WoS方法与闭合形式测试吻合度达0.75%。在背光、厚度主导场景下优于基准，但在前光或弯曲场景下表现有限。

Conclusion: 本文提出的厚度预测启发式在薄特征场景中有用，但弯曲和光照条件可能主导远离平板设置的场景。WoS方法减少了扩散模型内的几何误差，但不能替代完整的辐射传输方程求解。

Abstract: The dipole and its descendants model subsurface scattering with a radial reflectance profile fitted to a flat, semi-infinite slab. This assumption introduces a systematic geometry error on thin and curved objects. We isolate the effect by comparing the dipole with the finite-slab multipole under the same diffusion model and boundary condition. In slab geometry the diffuse-albedo error has a material-independent leading rate, $C e^{-2τ}$ with $τ=T/\ell_d$, while the prefactor remains material dependent; the same image series gives the transmitted flux, whose leading decay is $e^{-τ}$. We give the closed-form albedo and transmittance, relate the exponents to killed random walks, and extend the interpretation to spatially varying media through optical distance. A brute-force volumetric path tracer fits a reflectance-deficit rate of 1.99 and a transmittance rate of 0.99, matching the round-trip and single-pass predictions. The resulting thickness predictor is a useful thin-feature heuristic, but stress tests show that curvature and illumination can dominate away from the slab setting. For the remaining geometry-dependent term we solve the screened-Poisson diffusion problem directly inside the signed-distance domain with Walk on Spheres, without an interior mesh or a tangent half-space approximation; the estimator matches closed-form tests to 0.75%. Against a four-case path-traced benchmark it improves the back-lit, thickness-governed case but not every front-lit or curved case, showing that the method reduces geometry error within diffusion and does not replace radiative transport.

</details>


### [380] [Rendering Coherent Scattering via Quantum Collision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29989)
*João S. Ferreira,Spencer S. Topel,Pierre Fromholz,James R. Wootton*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合经典光线追踪与量子碰撞模型的渲染框架，将光与物质的相互作用视为量子化的碰撞过程，利用量子计算机预计算BSDF，实现具有混沌光学响应和非可积动力学的新型物理材质渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统渲染假设材质光学属性静态，无法处理光照激发下属性动态演化的场景。本文旨在突破这一局限，引入量子光-物质相互作用模型来捕捉更丰富的物理光学现象。

Method: 将入射光和材料激发态视为量子化模式，将次表面散射建模为一系列对称性约束的幺正碰撞，结合经典光线追踪与量子碰撞模型，在近-term量子计算机上预计算碰撞算子以生成标准BSDF。

Result: 实现了具有非可积分动力学、混沌光学响应及多层干涉效应等新型物理材质的高效渲染。

Conclusion: 该框架能够生成具有独特光学特征的新颖材质，拓展了计算机图形学中物理基渲染的表达边界。

Abstract: Traditional light rendering techniques treat the optical properties of materials as static, yet this assumption breaks down in cases where these properties dynamically evolve in response to incident illumination. We present a novel shading framework that combines classical ray-tracing with a quantum collision model to explore the effect of coherent light-matter interactions in rendering. By treating incident light and material excitations as quantized modes, we model sub-surface scattering as a sequence of symmetry-constrained unitary collisions. This formulation allows for the incorporation of non-integrable dynamics and chaotic optical responses due to multi-layer interference effects. We demonstrate how these collision operators can be pre-computed using near-term quantum computers to generate standard BSDFs, enabling the rendering of new physics-inspired materials with distinct optical signatures.

</details>


### [381] [RenderFormer++: Scalable and Physically Grounded Feed-Forward Neural Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30380)
*Huangsheng Du,Haoran Zhu,Youcheng Cai,Jinyang Meng,Ligang Liu*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: RenderFormer++ 提出了一种可扩展且物理可信的前馈神经渲染框架，通过物理信息传输引导（PITG）和层次化对象中心分词（HOCT）解决了全局光照渲染中的物理一致性差和可扩展性不足问题，在大规模复杂场景中实现了优于先前方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的神经渲染方法（如RenderFormer）虽具有良好的跨场景泛化能力，但由于三角形级分词带来的二次注意力复杂度，存在物理一致性不足和可扩展性差的问题。

Method: 1) 物理信息传输引导（PITG）：将渲染方程的归纳偏置嵌入注意力机制，并施加传输一致性损失；2) 层次化对象中心分词（HOCT）：通过可学习查询的交叉注意力将三角形级特征聚合为紧凑的对象级令牌，降低计算和内存开销。

Result: 在复杂大规模场景中实现了可扩展、稳定且可泛化的前馈全局光照渲染，物理准确性和效率均优于先前神经渲染方法。

Conclusion: RenderFormer++ 通过物理引导和层次化分词策略，在保持几何与辐射信息的同时显著提升了神经渲染的可扩展性和物理一致性。

Abstract: We present RenderFormer++, a scalable and physically grounded feed-forward neural rendering framework for global illumination in mesh scenes. Existing Transformer-based neural rendering methods such as RenderFormer achieve promising cross-scene generalization, but suffer from limited physical consistency and poor scalability due to the quadratic attention complexity of triangle-level tokenization. To address these issues, we introduce Physics-Informed Transport Guidance (PITG), which embeds rendering-equation inductive biases into the attention mechanism and enforces transport consistency loss, enabling physically consistent light transport modeling. We further propose Hierarchical Object-Centric Tokenization (HOCT), which aggregates triangle-level features into compact object-level tokens via cross-attention with learnable queries, substantially reducing computational and memory costs while preserving geometric and radiometric information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RenderFormer++ achieves scalable, stable, and generalizable feed-forward global illumination rendering across complex large-scale scenes with improved physical accuracy and efficiency over prior neural rendering methods.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [382] [Recursive Self-Evolving Agents via Held-Out Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28374)
*Michael Nguyen,Quoc Nguyen,Paul Vuong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RSEA（递归自进化智能体），通过维护三层自然语言状态（策略、技能、剧本）并采用严格保留最优门控机制进行自我进化。在四个基准测试中与六个基线方法对比发现：没有任何一种工件方法普遍最优；无保护的上下文进化高方差且不安全；RSEA的严格保留选择机制确保了递归自进化的单调安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体通过进化自然语言工件（如反思、工作流、提示优化等）来改进性能，但这些方法通常只在单一基准上报告优势，缺乏公平、系统的跨方法对比。本文旨在进行苹果对苹果的比较，揭示不同进化方法的真实表现差异和潜在风险。

Method: RSEA维护三层自然语言状态：命令式策略（strategy）、可复用技能（skills）和程序式剧本（playbook）。每一代中，RSEA从自身轨迹重写所有三层，并使用严格保留最优门控（strict keep-better gate）：仅当候选版本在不重叠的保留验证集上不退化时才提交。在四个基准（ALFWorld, GAIA, τ-bench, WebShop）上与六个基线（ReAct, Reflexion, GEPA, AWM, ACE, Dynamic Cheatsheet）使用同一本地骨干模型进行公平对比。

Result: (1) RSEA在ALFWorld上是最强单次方法（69.3% vs ReAct 64.6%, p=0.015），带重试达79.4%为最优；但AWM在强骨干工具使用任务上最佳。(2) 无保护的上下文进化（Dynamic Cheatsheet）在ALFWorld上接近最优（70.7%），但在WebShop上崩溃（0.14 vs ReAct 0.43）。(3) RSEA的严格保留选择确保了单调安全性：从未在任何基准上显著低于基础智能体，当进化上下文有害时自动回退到vanilla ReAct。

Conclusion: 没有任何单一自然语言工件方法能够普遍制胜；无保护的上下文进化存在高风险和不稳定性；严格的门控机制是确保递归自进化安全有效的关键。RSEA通过保守的保留策略实现了性能提升与安全性的平衡。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly improved without weight updates by evolving a natural-language artifact, such as reflections, workflows, playbooks, cheatsheets, or optimized prompts, that conditions a frozen policy. Such methods are typically reported as wins on the single benchmark where they help. We study them apples-to-apples and surface a sharper picture. We introduce RSEA, a Recursive Self-Evolving Agent that carries a compact three-layer natural-language state: an imperative strategy, reusable skills, and a procedural playbook. Across generations, RSEA rewrites all three layers from its own trajectories and commits a candidate only if it does not regress on a disjoint held-out split, using a strict keep-better gate.
  Across four diverse benchmarks, ALFWorld, GAIA, (τ)-bench, and WebShop, and six faithful baselines, ReAct, Reflexion, GEPA, AWM, ACE, and Dynamic Cheatsheet, all evaluated on one shared local backbone, we find three main results. First, no artifact universally wins. RSEA is the strongest single-pass method on ALFWorld, reaching 69.3% compared with 64.6% for ReAct (McNemar (p=0.015)), and reaches 79.4% with retry, the best overall result. However, concrete-workflow induction, represented by AWM, is best on the strong-backbone tool-use tasks. Second, unguarded context evolution is high-variance and unsafe. Dynamic Cheatsheet, which curates context online without a held-out gate, is near-best on ALFWorld at 70.7%, yet collapses on WebShop, with a score of 0.14 compared with 0.43 for ReAct. Third, RSEA's strict held-out selection is what makes recursive self-evolution monotone-safe: it never significantly underperforms the base agent on any benchmark and falls back to vanilla ReAct when evolved context would hurt.

</details>


### [383] [Data and Evaluation Closed-Loop for Model Capability Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28471)
*Zhixuan Li,Jiangan Yuan,Han Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"能力切片"(capability slice)概念，将评估样本按背景条件、任务类型、求解操作和输出约束分组，建立评估-数据闭环映射，实现从基准测试失败到针对性数据干预的可审计推理。两个案例验证：诊断出BBH下降源于<EOS>掩码损失而非推理能力削弱（恢复后超越原始检查点），以及通过操作分解定位数学推理弱点并用针对性采样提升AIME成绩（从6.67/0.00到26.67/26.67）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型预训练中，模型能力是核心变量但无法直接观测，数据塑造能力是前向过程，评估揭示能力是后向过程，两者使用不兼容的词汇表（基准名/样本正确性 vs 数据源/领域/质量标签）。工程师观察到失败后只能凭直觉推断数据修复方案，缺乏系统化方法。

Method: 提出"能力切片"(capability slice)作为分析单元，按四个维度分组评估样本：背景条件、任务类型、求解操作、输出约束。基于此构建评估分类法、非指令数据分类法和映射规则，形成闭环系统：将基准级失败转化为可测试的针对性数据干预。

Result: 案例一：连续预训练导致BBH下降46.82%，诊断发现原因是一个掩码的<EOS>损失而非推理能力弱化，修复后BBH恢复至66.44（超越原始检查点）。案例二：持久数学推理弱点通过操作分解定位到特定失败组合，针对性采样将AIME2025/AIME2026 Pass@128从6.67/0.00提升至26.67/26.67。

Conclusion: 相同未修改的闭环系统在两个相反案例中均得出正确结论，证明评估到数据的推断可以成为常规化、可审计、可实验验证的过程，而非依赖直觉。

Abstract: Model capability is the central variable in LLM pre-training, yet is never observed directly: data shapes it prospectively, while evaluation reveals it only retrospectively, compressing samples, prompts, decoding, and scoring rules into one noisy score. Practical optimization runs this backward: a failure is observed first, and the engineer must infer the corpus fix. The two sides speak incompatible vocabularies -- benchmark names and per-sample correctness versus data sources, domains, and quality labels -- so this inference is usually intuition, not method. We close this gap with the \emph{capability slice}: a group of evaluation samples sharing background condition, task type, solving operation, and output constraint -- precise enough to localize a single weakness yet stable enough to survive aggregation, unlike a benchmark name, too coarse, or a single sample, too noisy. Built around this unit, an evaluation taxonomy, a non-instruction data taxonomy, and mapping rules form a closed loop turning a benchmark-level failure into a targeted, testable data intervention. We test this loop on two case studies pulling in opposite directions. First, the loop rules the data out: continued pre-training drives BBH down by $-46.82\%$, but diagnosis traces this to a single masked \texttt{\textless EOS\textgreater} loss rather than weakened reasoning; restoring it recovers BBH to $66.44$, above the original checkpoint, without changing the data. Second, the loop rules the data in: a persistent math-reasoning weakness is decomposed by solving operation into specific failing combinations, and a weakness-targeted sampling procedure built from it lifts AIME2025/AIME2026 Pass@128 from $6.67$/$0.00$ to $26.67$ each. The same unmodified loop reaches opposite, correct verdicts in both cases, showing the evaluation-to-data inference can be routine, auditable, and experimentally validated rather than intuitive.

</details>


### [384] [GPTNT: Benchmarking Real-Time Collaboration Between Multimodal Agents on Keep Talking And Nobody Explodes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28514)
*Amit Parekh,Sabrina McCallum,Kareem Al-Hasan,Malvina Nikandrou,Alessandro Suglia,Ioannis Konstas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GPTNT基准，基于合作游戏《Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes》评估多模态模型在时间压力、信息不对称、异步实时通讯条件下的协作能力。实验表明所有当前模型均无法在实时条件下成功拆弹（人类可完成），揭示了模型在状态跟踪、高压决策、歧义处理、错误恢复等方面的关键缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准孤立研究时间压力、信息不对称、不完美通信等协作条件，缺乏同时考察这些要素的综合评估方法，无法测量模型在真实协作场景中的表现。

Method: 基于合作视频游戏《Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes》构建基准，两个智能体需通过实时异步通信协作拆除程序生成的炸弹。通过扣留指令手册、合作伙伴等控制实验分离协作能力与记忆依赖。

Result: 所有测试的闭源和开源模型均无法在实时条件下完成一次拆弹，而人类玩家可以。模型在状态跟踪、时间压力下高效行动、歧义处理、错误恢复方面存在关键弱点。

Conclusion: GPTNT揭示了当前多模态模型在协作能力上的显著不足，现有评估未能覆盖这些维度。基准受益于程序生成和活跃的模组社区，可随模型改进持续演化。

Abstract: Multimodal models are increasingly deployed to solve tasks collaboratively with humans or other artificial agents. Existing benchmarks show that these models possess many of the required component capabilities, but the conditions that coincide in collaboration, including time pressure, information asymmetry, and imperfect communication, are usually studied in isolation. We introduce GPTNT, a benchmark built on the cooperative video game Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes, in which two agents must coordinate to defuse procedurally generated bomb puzzles against a live countdown. One agent can see and manipulate the bomb but does not have the defusal instructions; the other has the instructions but cannot see or manipulate the bomb. Neither agent can succeed alone: success requires effective and efficient communication. Unlike turn-based proxies, GPTNT requires agents to act asynchronously and communicate in real time. GPTNT is designed to separate collaboration from reliance on memorized solutions: the instruction manual, the partner, or both can be withheld to isolate what a model derives in the moment from what it already knows. We show that GPTNT poses a substantial challenge for state-of-the-art systems: none of the closed- or open-source models we test defuses a single bomb in real time, a bar that human players clear. Through controlled experiments, we identify critical weaknesses in state tracking, efficient action under time pressure, ambiguity handling, and error recovery. We release GPTNT as a benchmark for collaborative performance that current evaluations leave unmeasured. Because it runs on the real game, GPTNT benefits from procedural generation and inherits a living modding community, allowing the benchmark to evolve as models improve rather than being solved once and retired.

</details>


### [385] [IMCBench: A benchmark for multimodal LLMs in Image-grounded Medical Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28556)
*Maria Xenochristou,Ashutosh Joshi,Korosh Vatanparvar,Mohammad Abuzar Hashemi,Prasad Kasu,Deepak Bansal,Anchal Nema,Nivedita Wadhwa,Prashams S Jain,Rebecca Abraham,Will Kimbrough,Dilek Hakkani-Tur,Wilko Schulz-Mahlendorf*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: IMCBench 是一个基于图像的多轮医疗对话基准，通过真实临床图像与合成患者档案模拟医患交互，从安全性、准确性和不确定性表达三个维度评估多模态模型。实验表明，Claude Opus 4.6 综合表现最佳（3.61分），但无模型在所有维度占优，且视觉和EHR上下文对安全指导至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗AI基准存在碎片化问题：有的支持多轮对话但缺少图像，有的提供多模态输入但仅限单轮问答。缺乏能同时具备图像基础和多轮对话能力的评估基准。

Method: 构建IMCBench，使用真实公开临床图像与合成患者档案配对，生成多轮医患对话。采用LLM-as-Jury评分（1-5分制），校准临床专家标注，从安全性、准确性、不确定性表达三个维度评估。对8个前沿模型（Claude、GPT、Nova、Llama四大家族）进行基准测试，并进行消融研究移除视觉输入或EHR上下文。

Result: Claude Opus 4.6 总分最高（3.61），其次为 Claude Sonnet 4.6（3.30）和 GPT-5.2（3.29）。无模型在所有维度占优，恶性及罕见病症安全性均下降（Δ=-0.27）。消融实验显示移除视觉输入和EHR上下文分别导致安全性下降0.18和0.23。

Conclusion: 准确的临床描述不能保证安全的患者指导，医疗AI评估需要多维度框架。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models and vision-language models have enabled reasoning over multimodal data, offering opportunities for clinical applications such as decision support and triaging. However, existing medical AI benchmarks are fragmented: some support multi-turn dialogues but lack images, while others provide multimodal inputs but focus on single-turn QA tasks. To address this gap, we introduce IMCBench, an image-grounded, multi-turn medical conversation benchmark that pairs real, publicly available clinical images with synthetic patient profiles to simulate realistic patient-clinician interactions. Each conversation is evaluated across three clinical dimensions: safety, accuracy, and appropriate use of uncertainty in diagnosis. We benchmark eight multimodal frontier models across four model families (Claude, GPT, Nova, and Llama), scoring each on a 1-5 scale using LLM-as-Jury scoring calibrated against expert clinician annotations. Our results show that Claude Opus 4.6 achieves the highest overall score (3.61), followed by Claude Sonnet 4.6 (3.30) and GPT-5.2 (3.29), though no model dominates all dimensions and safety degrades for both malignant and rare conditions ($Δ$ = -0.27 each). Ablation studies further reveal that both visual input and EHR context contribute to safe guidance (safety drops of 0.18 and 0.23 on average when each is removed), with stronger models leveraging visual features more effectively. Together, these findings demonstrate that accurate clinical description does not guarantee safe patient guidance, motivating the need for multi-dimensional evaluation frameworks in medical AI.

</details>


### [386] [Search for Truth from Reasoning: A Dynamic Representation Editing Framework for Steering LLM Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28589)
*Tianlong Wang,Yuhang Wang,Weibin Liao,Xin Gao,Xinyu Ma,Yang Lin,Yasha Wang,Liantao Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DynaSteer，一种动态表示编辑框架，通过解耦推理轨迹中的真理几何结构，利用模式聚类和Fisher-LDA提取纯净真理信号，并结合前瞻熵监控选择性干预推理路径，在数学推理和代码生成任务上显著提升LLM推理的真实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（如CoT、"Wait"提示）虽鼓励模型多思考，但未能有效引导模型走向真实答案；表示编辑（RepE）虽提供内在控制，但在动态推理轨迹中的应用尚属空白。

Method: DynaSteer包含三个核心组件：(1) 模式聚类解耦推理流形；(2) Fisher-LDA投影提纯真理信号；(3) 基于前瞻熵的动态监控，选择性干预并回滚推理轨迹。

Result: 在多个MATH基准测试上验证了有效性，并在域外代码任务上证实了泛化能力。

Conclusion: 揭示了推理链中真理编码的三个关键洞察（句子级编码、不确定性原理与衰减效应、噪声风险），并证明动态选择性干预是提升LLM推理真实性的有效范式。

Abstract: Current approaches to enhance Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, such as Chain-of-Thought and "Wait" prompts, primarily encourage models to think more, yet often fail to guide them toward Truth. While Representation Editing (RepE) offers a intrinsic control, its application to dynamic reasoning trajectories remains underexplored. In this work, we bridge this gap by investigating the geometry of truth within unfolding reasoning chains. We uncover three critical insights: (1) Truth is encoded at the sentence level and is entangled with latent reasoning patterns; (2) Effective intervention follows an Uncertainty Principle and a Decay Effect, requiring localization to early, high-entropy forks; (3) Naive steering vectors suffer from noise, risking collateral damage to correct trajectories. Based on these findings, we propose DynaSteer, a dynamic RepE framework. DynaSteer employs pattern clustering to disentangle reasoning manifolds and utilizes Fisher-LDA to project purified truth. By dynamically monitoring lookahead entropy, it selectively steers and rolls back trajectories only when necessary. Comprehensive experimental results on several MATH benchmark verify the effectiveness of DynaSteer, and experiments on out-of-domain coding tasks further confirm its generalization ability. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/tianlwang/DynaSteer.

</details>


### [387] [Aristotelian Virtue Profiling of LLMs through Ethical Dilemmas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28683)
*Ioannis Tzachristas,John Pavlopoulos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VirtueMap是一个基于亚里士多德美德伦理学的框架，通过对七个非致命、非政治、非宗教的道德困境中的五个回答进行排序，并利用标准化Borda对齐评分，来刻画LLM在实践智慧、正义、诚实、勇气和节制五种美德上的表现模式。在9个LLM家族上测试显示平均排序一致性达90.3%，主要差异出现在勇气、节制和正义维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在伦理决策中常面临多种可辩护但体现不同优先级的回答之间的权衡，现有方法往往寻求单一正确答案，无法捕捉这种美德层面的多样性。

Method: 提出VirtueMap框架：1）设计7个通用伦理困境，每个困境包含5个回答；2）针对每个困境和每种美德，由人工提出回答的排序顺序，经95%以上确认作为参考标准；3）使用标准化Borda对齐方法将模型排序与参考排序进行对比评分；4）输出涵盖实践智慧、正义、诚实、勇气和节制五种美德的剖面图。

Result: 在9个LLM家族上进行重复评估，平均排序一致性达90.3%；最大的差异出现在勇气、节制和正义维度上。

Conclusion: VirtueMap能够有效刻画LLM在不同美德维度上的伦理偏好模式，并提供了一个可交互的网站用于本地计算和比较分析。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often face ethical tradeoffs in which several responses may be defensible but express different priorities, such as fairness, honesty, courage, or restraint. We introduce VirtueMap, a framework for describing these patterns through an Aristotelian virtue-ethics lens. Instead of asking for a single correct answer, VirtueMap asks humans or LLMs to rank all five responses to each of seven general, non-lethal, non-political, and non-religious ethical dilemmas. To define the reference orderings used for scoring, we first proposed, for each dilemma and virtue, an ordering of the five responses from most to least expressive of that virtue. We then collected more than 100 respondent evaluations per ordering and retained it as operational ground truth only when at least 95% confirmed it. Rankings are scored against these retained orderings using normalized Borda alignment, yielding profiles over Practical Wisdom, Justice, Truthfulness, Courage, and Temperance. We apply VirtueMap to nine LLM families in a repeated-run evaluation and find high mean rank consistency (90.3%), with the largest differences appearing on Courage, Temperance, and Justice. We also release an interactive website that computes profiles locally in the browser and compares respondents with measured LLM profiles.

</details>


### [388] [An AI agent for treatment reasoning over a biomedical tool universe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28692)
*Shanghua Gao,Ayush Noori,Richard Zhu,Curtis Ginder,Zhenglun Kong,Xiaorui Su,Justin Kauffman,Benjamin S. Glicksberg,Joshua Lampert,Ankit Sakhuja,Ashwin Sawant,ATHENA-R1 Evaluation Consortium,David A. Clifton,Noa Dagan,Ran Balicer,Marinka Zitnik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ATHENA-R1，一个通过强化学习在212个生物医学工具上训练的治疗推理AI智能体。它采用两级自学习框架：多智能体系统构建工具、任务和推理轨迹进行监督微调，再通过强化学习优化推理质量。在5个基准测试中，ATHENA-R1在开放药物推理任务上达到94.7%准确率，在治疗推理上达到82.9%，分别超过GPT-5达17.8和10.7个百分点。专家盲评和医生评估均显示其优越性，在540万患者电子健康记录中验证的不良事件假设调整后优势比达1.48-1.84。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 治疗推理是临床决策的核心，需要整合疾病背景、合并症、药物、禁忌症等多维信息，并基于可验证来源进行迭代推理。然而，由于AI需要知道在得出结论前该寻找什么证据，治疗推理长期以来对AI而言极具挑战性。现有语言模型和工具使用系统在治疗推理任务上表现不足，缺乏可扩展且无需人工标注的训练方法。

Method: 提出ATHENA-R1，一个基于强化学习的AI治疗推理智能体。通过两级自学习框架训练：(1) 第一级利用多智能体系统构建212个生物医学工具、任务和推理轨迹，进行监督微调；(2) 第二级通过强化学习配合科学反馈（评估证据收集、工具使用、逻辑非冗余性）优化推理质量。模型在每步推理中识别缺失信息，选择并运行相关工具，整合证据，迭代优化候选治疗方案。

Result: 在5个基准测试（共3,168个药物推理任务和456个患者治疗案例）上，ATHENA-R1在开放药物推理任务中达94.7%准确率，治疗推理达82.9%，分别超过GPT-5达17.8和10.7个百分点。来自28个罕见病组织的专家盲评中，其在所有评价标准上均优于参考模型。医生对复杂住院心血管和感染性疾病案例评估中给予积极评价。在540万患者电子健康记录中验证的不良事件假设，调整后优势比达1.48-1.84，阴性对照无异常升高。

Conclusion: 治疗推理可以重新定义为一种可通过强化学习训练的可学习迭代证据收集过程。ATHENA-R1证明了无需人工标注轨迹即可训练AI进行复杂治疗推理的可行性，通过工具使用和强化学习的结合，AI能够学习在得出结论前主动寻求必要证据，在临床推理任务上显著超越现有最先进系统。

Abstract: Treatment reasoning underpins every therapeutic decision, integrating disease context, comorbidities, medications, contraindications, and evolving biomedical knowledge to select an appropriate therapy. It is inherently iterative: candidates are weighed against many constraints, revised as evidence emerges, and grounded in verifiable sources. Here we introduce ATHENA-R1, an AI agent for treatment reasoning across all FDA approved drugs since 1939, trained by reinforcement learning over a universe of 212 biomedical tools. At each step it identifies missing information, selects and runs relevant tools, and incorporates the evidence. To train it without human-annotated traces, we build a two-level self-learning framework: multi-agent systems construct the tools, tasks, and reasoning trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then reinforcement learning with scientific feedback rewards reasoning quality (evidence gathering, grounded tool use, logical non-redundancy). Across five benchmarks of 3,168 drug reasoning tasks and 456 patient treatment cases, ATHENA-R1 outperforms language models and tool-use systems, reaching 94.7% accuracy on open-ended drug reasoning and 82.9% on treatment reasoning, 17.8 and 10.7 points above GPT-5.
